heading: Notifications
enabled_help: Users can opt in to a personal notification inbox and site alerts for their servers. Disabling this hides notification controls and stops new notifications and deliveries. Action confirmation toasts remain available.
discord_help: Users can choose events and save their own Discord incoming webhook. Webhook URLs are encrypted and never shown back to users. Disabling this also stops queued Discord deliveries.
retention: Notifications are kept for 30 days. The standard scheduler and low-priority queue worker must be running.
crashes: Crash alerts require the daemon to report server:crash or server:crashed through the authenticated activity API. Stock Wings does not send this event. Normal stops are never assumed to be crashes.
discord_disabled: Personal Discord webhooks are disabled by the administrator.
invalid_webhook: Enter a valid Discord incoming webhook URL.
webhook_required: Save a Discord webhook before selecting Discord events.
